query:
SELECT a.id, a.date, a.checkInTime, a.checkOutTime, a.durationMinutes, a.createdAt, a.packageId, r.name
FROM attendances a
JOIN residents r ON a.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.name = 'enka enka'
ORDER BY a.createdAt;
